name: Azure resource tags
short_description: Tags are key-value metadata pairs attached to Azure resources, resource groups and subscriptions to organize them and to group costs by project, department, environment or owner.

evidence.quote: Tags are simple key value payers you attach to resources.
Your tagging strategy is the foundation here. It's non-negotiable.
enforce strict tagging and utilization standards
Cost center and owner are non-negotiable.
Tagging is not etiquette. Tagging is financial identity.
